description: Deldatasett aktsomhet jord- og flomskred is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. «Deldatasett aktsomhet jord- og flomskred» (2025) er en del av NVEs kombinerte "aktsomhetskart for jord- og flomskred". NVEs "aktsomhetskart for jord- og flomskred" viser potensielle utløpsområder for ulike typer løsmasseskred. Det omfatter ikke kvikkleireskred og grunne utglidninger i lave løsmasseskråninger, og ikke masseførende flom. Coverage: Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. The publisher named on the listing is Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. Its keywords include Samfunnssikkerhet, National. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GEOJSON, SHP, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
